_about: What a compose file may ask of the host: the exceptions DCS ships (docs/SECURITY.md, 'Compose policy').
Every compose file DCS writes or starts is judged by .lib/compose-policy.jq. A finding is refused (root on the host
in all but name) or warned. An entry below allows the rules it names for an image (by prefix: 'netdata/netdata'
matches netdata/netdata:stable) or a stack, optionally only for a service name; '*' in a rule matches anything.
An allowed refusal is still reported as a warning, an allowed warning is listed as allowed. This server's own
entries go in .data/compose-policy.local.json (GET/PUT /config/compose-policy), never in this file: an update
replaces it. An image allowed here is trusted not to be pointed elsewhere: its entrypoint and command are not judged.
